data.name: Arjun
data.gender_notes: Arjun is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit arjuna, 'white, bright, clear', also the name of a tree and a peacock. Its root is Sanskrit arjuna (अर्जुन). Arjuna, the Pandava hero of the Mahabharata and Bhagavad Gita. Arjun is a Sanskrit name meaning “Bright; shining; white; the peacock”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arjun expresses “Bright; shining; white; the peacock”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit arjuna, 'white, bright, clear', also the name of a tree and a peacock.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjun total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
